es: Responder una entrevista sobre la propia vida: un recuerdo contado con distancia, una opinión actual con continuo de actitud y una petición cortés.

usesVocabulary: if you don't mind me asking

vocabulary.en: if you don't mind me asking
vocabulary.es: si no le importa que pregunte

teaching.en: In the interview, she was asked to reflect on her childhood in a small village, which she called the most formative period of her life.
teaching.es: En la entrevista le pidieron que reflexionara sobre su infancia en un pueblo pequeño, que calificó como la etapa más formativa de su vida.
teaching.explanationEs: Reflect on es pensar con calma sobre algo vivido; formative describe lo que marca cómo eres.
segments: In the interview, she was asked to reflect on her childhood in a
small village, which she called the most formative period of her life.

teaching.en: My earliest memory is of a yellow kitchen where my grandmother would bake bread every Saturday while I sat and watched.
teaching.es: Mi primer recuerdo es una cocina amarilla donde mi abuela solía hornear pan cada sábado mientras yo me sentaba a mirar.
teaching.explanationEs: Would + verbo base cuenta una costumbre del recuerdo; sat and watched es el fondo en pasado simple.
segments: My earliest memory is of a yellow kitchen where my grandmother
would bake bread every Saturday while I sat and watched.
teaching.audioText: My earliest memory is of a yellow kitchen where my grandmother would bake bread every Saturday while I sat and watched.

teaching.en: At that time, in my childhood, I was living with my grandparents, and I had never seen the sea before our first trip.
teaching.es: En aquella época, en mi infancia, vivía con mis abuelos y nunca había visto el mar antes de nuestro primer viaje.
teaching.explanationEs: Was living da el fondo de la escena; had never seen marca algo anterior a ese momento.
segments: At that time, in my childhood, I was living with my grandparents,
and I had never seen the sea before our first trip.
teaching.audioText: At that time, in my childhood, I was living with my grandparents, and I had never seen the sea before our first trip.

teaching.en: These days I'm being more candid about my opinion, even when others disagree, because honest feedback is rarely welcome at first.
teaching.es: Hoy en día estoy siendo más franco con mi opinión, aunque otros no estén de acuerdo, porque la sinceridad rara vez se agradece al principio.
teaching.explanationEs: These days + be being: actitud actual distinta de antes; candid es decir lo que piensas sin rodeos.
segments: These days I'm being more candid about my opinion, even when
others disagree, because honest feedback is rarely welcome at first.
teaching.audioText: These days I'm being more candid about my opinion, even when others disagree, because honest feedback is rarely welcome at first.

teaching.en: The interviewer asked what I was doing in those years, and I replied that I was hoping to become a teacher.
teaching.es: El entrevistador me preguntó qué hacía yo en esos años, y respondí que esperaba ser profesor.
teaching.explanationEs: Was doing recoge la escena de fondo; was hoping cuenta una esperanza de entonces.
segments: The interviewer asked what I was doing in those years, and
I replied that I was hoping to become a teacher.

teaching.en: If you don't mind me asking, I was wondering if you could repeat the question, because I didn't catch the last part.
teaching.es: Si no le importa que se lo pregunte, me preguntaba si podría repetir la pregunta, porque no he oído la última parte.
teaching.explanationEs: If you don't mind me asking suaviza una pregunta personal; I was wondering if you could mantiene la petición cortés.

prompt.es: La entrevistadora pregunta por tu infancia. ¿Qué respuesta cuenta un hábito pasado?

choices.text: Last summer we would swim in the river near my grandparents' house.
Every summer we would swim in the river near my grandparents' house.
Every summer we have been swimming in the river near my grandparents' house.

feedback.es: Every summer + would + verbo base cuenta una costumbre repetida; con un momento concreto (last summer) o con el present perfect continuous no se expresa un hábito pasado.

hint.es: Busca would + verbo base con una marca de repetición.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hoy en día estoy siendo más franco con mi opinión, aunque no guste.»

feedback.es: These days + be being marca una actitud actual distinta de la habitual: I'm being candid.

hint.es: Es la forma -ing de be que marca una actitud del momento.

origin.text: These days I'm ___ more candid about my opinion, even when it is not what people want to hear.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Si no le importa que se lo pregunte, ¿dónde vivía entonces?»

answer.text: If you don't mind me asking, where were you living then
accepted: If you don't mind me asking, where were you living then
If you don't mind me asking where were you living then

feedback.es: If you don't mind me asking abre la pregunta con tacto, y were you living devuelve la pregunta a la escena de fondo del pasado.

hint.es: Empieza por la fórmula de cortesía y cierra con then.

prompt.es: Escucha el fragmento y elige qué actitud tiene hoy la entrevistada hacia su infancia.

choices.text: She regrets having left the village when she was a girl.
She prefers not to discuss those years any more.
She is open about the hard parts and still enjoys remembering.

feedback.es: These days is being more candid y is loving the memories muestran que reconoce los momentos duros y aun así disfruta del recuerdo.

origin.audio: In a radio interview, a retired teacher looks back on her childhood. At that time she was living with her grandparents in a tiny village, and every morning she would walk three kilometres to school. She had never seen the sea, so when her uncle took her to the coast at twelve, she was surprised. These days she is being far more candid about those years, admitting that she was often lonely, although she is loving the memories now.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada marca de la entrevista con su perspectiva.

pairs: I was wondering if you could
if you don't mind me asking

feedback.es: At that time lleva al pasado, these days al presente, y las dos fórmulas de cortesía suavizan una petición o una pregunta personal.

pairs: I was wondering if you could
if you don't mind me asking

prompt.es: Lee el intercambio. ¿Qué actitud muestra ella ante la etiqueta de «infancia difícil»?

choices.text: She politely disagrees by focusing on the love she received.
She accepts the label but says it made her stronger.
She avoids the question by joking about the sea.

feedback.es: Would they? y la alusión a quienes la querían muestran que rechaza con educación la etiqueta, sin negar el dato del mar.

origin.text: Interviewer: 'You said you never saw the sea until you were twelve. Some people would call that a difficult childhood.' Guest: 'Would they? I was living with people who loved me, so I'd say it was a full one.'

prompt.es: Escucha la respuesta y elige qué actitud tiene hoy el hablante hacia sus recuerdos.

choices.text: He enjoys them but avoids speaking about them.
He enjoys them and speaks openly about them.
He speaks openly about them but dislikes them.

feedback.es: I'm being more candid y I'm loving the memories indican que habla con franqueza y disfruta del recuerdo: ni lo evita ni lo rechaza.

origin.audio: When I was a child, I lived in a small village. Every morning I would walk to school, and by then my grandmother had already made the fire. These days I'm being more candid about those years, and I'm loving the memories, although I know I was lucky. Could I ask you something? I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview, if it is no trouble.

prompt.es: Con la misma respuesta, ¿para qué usa el hablante «I was wondering if you could…»?

choices.text: To correct something the interviewer got wrong earlier.
To offer the interviewer a copy of his own recording.
To make a polite request to the interviewer.

feedback.es: I was wondering if you could send me… if it is no trouble es una petición cortés con distancia: pide la copia de la entrevista sin exigirla.

prompt.es: Completa: «Fueron los años más formativos de mi vida, porque me hicieron quien soy.»

feedback.es: Formative years son los años que marcan la formación de una persona; la frase que sigue (they shaped who I am) lo confirma.

origin.text: Those were the most ___ years of my life, because they shaped who I am today.

prompt.es: Responde la entrevista: un recuerdo, tu opinión actual y una petición cortés.

answer.text: My earliest memory is of my grandmother's kitchen. At that time I was living with my grandparents in a tiny village, and every morning I would wake up to the smell of fresh bread. I had never seen the sea, so on Sundays we used to walk to the river, and I remember it vividly. These days, my opinion of those years has changed, and I'm being more candid about them. I'm loving my quiet routine, but I feel nostalgic when I think about those long summers. Before we finish, if you don't mind me asking, I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview. I was hoping to show it to my family, because I'm very grateful for this chance.
accepted: My earliest memory is of my grandmother's kitchen. At that time I was living with my grandparents in a tiny village, and every morning I would wake up to the smell of fresh bread. I had never seen the sea, so on Sundays we used to walk to the river, and I remember it vividly. These days, my opinion of those years has changed, and I'm being more candid about them. I'm loving my quiet routine, but I feel nostalgic when I think about those long summers. Before we finish, if you don't mind me asking, I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview. I was hoping to show it to my family, because I'm very grateful for this chance.

When I was a child, I lived in a small village with my grandparents. At that time I was living a simple life, and every evening we would sit in the garden while my grandfather told stories. I had never travelled abroad, and I was very curious about the world. These days my opinion of those years is different: I'm being more candid about how much I missed my parents, and I'm loving the memories more than ever. If you don't mind me asking, I was wondering if you could send me a copy of the interview, if it is no trouble. I'd be very grateful, because my family would love to hear it.

Back then, I was living in a small town with my grandparents. Every summer we used to swim in the river, and I would listen to their stories for hours. By the time I was ten, I had already decided to become a teacher, although nobody knew it. These days I'm being more honest about those years, and I'm loving the quiet life I have now. Before we finish, I was hoping you could send me a copy of the interview, if it is no trouble. I would be very grateful, because I'd like my children to hear it.

feedback.es: La respuesta cuenta el recuerdo con distancia, da la opinión actual con continuo de actitud y pide la copia con una petición cortés.

origin.text: Entrevista. 1) «Cuéntame un recuerdo de tu infancia.» 2) «¿Qué opinas hoy de aquellos años?» 3) Pide con cortesía a la entrevistadora una copia de la entrevista. Escribe en inglés (160–210 palabras) un recuerdo con hábito pasado (would / used to) y un hecho anterior (had), tu opinión actual con un continuo de actitud (I'm being…, I'm loving…) y una petición con tiempo de distancia.

evidenceGroups: i was wondering if you could

prompt.es: Lee el intercambio. ¿Qué postura adopta el invitado sobre la infancia fácil?

choices.text: He partly rejects it, arguing that they lacked things but not ideas.
He agrees, but only because children then had fewer worries.
He rejects it completely and says they had everything they needed.

feedback.es: We had fewer things, but… richer in ideas muestran un desacuerdo matizado: admite que tenían menos cosas, pero rechaza que fuera fácil o pobre.

origin.text: Interviewer: 'Some people say your childhood was an easy one. Would you agree?' Guest: 'Well, we had fewer things, but I wouldn't call that hard. We used to make our own games, and honestly, I think we were richer in ideas than in money.'

prompt.es: Escucha el final de la entrevista y elige por qué pide la presentadora que repita.

choices.text: Because she missed the title herself while the guest was speaking.
Because many listeners did not catch the title.
Because the book has just come out and he wants people to buy it.

feedback.es: La presentadora lo explica con because many listeners missed it: usa I was wondering if you could para pedir con tacto que lo repita.

origin.audio: At the end of the radio interview, the presenter thanks her guest and says, I was wondering if you could repeat the title of your book, because many listeners missed it. The guest laughs and says, Of course, it's called Yellow Kitchen, and I wrote it while I was living in a tiny flat.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hizo una pausa para reflexionar sobre cómo su infancia la marcó.»

feedback.es: Reflect on es pensar con calma sobre algo vivido; el contexto de una pausa antes de responder y de una experiencia que «la había marcado» pide ese verbo.

origin.text: Before answering, she paused to ___ on how her childhood had shaped the person she was today.
